key_terms.يُحَاسَبُ: He will be called to account

ai.seo_question: Who will have an easy reckoning on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as referring to the Ahl al-Bayt or the faithful who, due to their high spiritual station and minor sins, will be judged with ease. It underscores the principle that divine mercy outweighs strict retribution for those who maintain closeness to God, contrasting with the severe accounting of the disbelievers.
